name: split-rows
description:
One row for each part of the cells of the working column, cut by sep.

The spaces at the edges of a part are trimmed, an empty part makes no row. The other columns are copied to each new row. A cell with no sep stays one row, an empty cell stays one row with an empty cell. A column that is not in the table is refused, naming the columns there are.

sep: the text that cuts a cell.

Example: semkit read reshape/cells.csv split-rows --sep ";" write -
-> диван, 7; софа, 7; кресло, 3

The step changes no other column. The working column stays the same.

options.name: --sep
options.description: the text that cuts a cell.
